title: Northgate Card Courtesy Points for How Late the Fee Statement Was Paid
content:
The lateness points that count toward a courtesy reversal of a late fee on a **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)** account follow the most recent payment recorded against the fee statement, counted in calendar days from the fee statement's payment due date to that payment's credit date, and of two credited the same day the one entered first:

- a payment credited 1 to 3 days after the due date grants 15 points;
- a payment credited 4 to 10 days after the due date grants 8 points;
- a payment credited on or before the due date or more than 10 days after it, or no payment, grants none.

The fee statement is the statement the courtesy late fee was recorded for — the most recent late fee on the account — and the payments recorded against it are the payment entries that carry its closing date.

| Most recent payment recorded against the fee statement | Lateness points |
|---|---|
| credited on or before the due date | none |
| credited 1, 2 or 3 days after the due date | 15 |
| credited 4 to 10 days after the due date | 8 |
| credited 11 or more days after the due date | none |
| no payment recorded against it | none |

Hypothetical illustration with a payment due date on the 9th: a payment credited on the 12th (3 days) grants 15 points; on the 13th (4 days), 8 points; on the 19th (10 days), 8 points; on the 20th (11 days), none.
